# sub-organization of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/subOrganizationOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an organization to a larger organization it is part of — a department or division within a company, a team within a department. Transitive (a team is part of the company through its division). A specialization of the universal [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) spine. A department is thus a first-class [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md), and a [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) may target it directly. The 'department' field is the sub-organization a person's membership is in.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) -> [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md) from [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) to [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to nest one organization inside a larger one — a department in a company, a team in a department — so the organizational part/whole hierarchy and membership propagation hold.

### Avoid when

- Avoid the generic [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) for organizational nesting (assert this and let [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) follow) and avoid it for non-organizational containment ([`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) for places); contested succession claims coexist via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md) from the sub-organization to its parent and let transitivity build the hierarchy; target a department directly with [`gmeow:membershipOrganization`](gmeow-membershipOrganization.md) so the [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md) property chain infers parent membership.
